classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by a separate prefetch process (_prefetch) that reads ahead into a bounded queue while the main loop sleeps for compute_s, so the read for each tile file overlaps with computation and no rank actually stalls on the read itself.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: in measure(), probe.read_staged(path_for(...,'masks',...)) is called synchronously in the main loop and its duration (gated) is timed before the compute sleep, so the calling rank stops and waits for each mask read to complete while no other rank is involved.
